final_message: I cleaned the data by removing duplicate order events, keeping only the first occurrence of each order id. I parsed the placed_at timestamps to UTC to accurately identify orders placed in March 2024 UTC. I normalized category names by trimming spaces and converting to lowercase. I excluded orders with missing totals (-1) from revenue calculations. I then calculated the total revenue and count of orders placed in March 2024 UTC, identified the top revenue category over the whole dataset, counted orders with missing totals, and counted the number of duplicate events removed. The results are saved in workspace/answer.json.
